style: True pixel art sprites, not a filtered photo. Each icon is a small integer texel drawing shown as chunky nearest-neighbor squares. Hard edges only. No anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no soft shadows. Limited shared palette: sesame cream, rust orange, white blaze, ink navy, moss green, warm graphite. Puppy-shop objects only. Never use magenta, electric cyan, the chroma-key color, or the guide-box color.
